item.title: Context Is the Bottleneck: Building a Knowledge Assistant for a Legacy Codebase
item.author: mattnorberg4@gmail.com (Matthew Norberg)
item.description: A keynote line about context sent me down the path of building a Databricks app that gives Genie Code full knowledge of a legacy codebase we’re reverse-engineering. Here’s why I built it, how it works, and why the same pattern can work for any codebase.
